answers.question: Why does the billing module have a cash point concept? Explain what it is used for and where it appears in code.

paragraphs.text: A cash point models **a physical cashier station** — "the cashier stations bills are raised at" [1]. The class doc says it is "a location where `Bill`s can be created and paid for" [2]. It is deliberately finer-grained than an OpenMRS `Location`: a `Location` is a building or ward, whereas a facility can have several cash desks inside one location (OPD desk, IPD desk, pharmacy till). It carries a `Location` reference so stations can be scoped and filtered [3].
It is a `BaseOpenmrsMetadata` subclass [4], persisted in the `cashier_cash_point` table with name, description, location and the standard retire/audit columns [5].

- **Attributing money to a station.** Every `Bill` references exactly one cash point (`not-null`) [6], exposed as the `cashPoint` field [7]. This is what makes cash reconciliation possible: you can total the takings of one desk.
- **Driving shift/cashier accounting.** A `Timesheet` (clock-in/clock-out for a cashier) is also tied to a cash point, also `not-null` [8], so a shift records *which station* the cashier was manning [9].
- **Receipt-number grouping.** The sequential receipt generator can group numbers by cash point: `GroupingType.CASH_POINT` prefixes the number with `cashPointPrefix + bill.getCashPoint().getId()`, and `CASHIER_AND_CASH_POINT` combines cashier and cash point [10]. The prefix is stored in the generator model [11].
- **Filtering and reporting.** Bills can be searched by cash point through `BillSearch.cashPointUuid` [12], fed from the REST `cashPointUuid` request parameter omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/BillResource.java. The frontend surfaces it per bill as `cashPointUuid` / `cashPointName` / `cashPointLocation` src/billing.resource.ts.

**Service / DAO**
- `CashPointService` interface, methods authorized with `PrivilegeConstants.MANAGE_METADATA` api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/CashPointService.java
- `CashPointServiceImpl`: CRUD plus location/name lookups; `getCashPointsByLocation` requires a non-null location api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/impl/CashPointServiceImpl.java; `getCashPointsByLocationAndName` validates name length against a 255-char cap api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/impl/CashPointServiceImpl.java; retire/unretire at api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/impl/CashPointServiceImpl.java
- DAO contract `CashPointDAO` api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/db/CashPointDAO.java, implemented by `HibernateCashPointDAOImpl` api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/db/hibernate/HibernateCashPointDAOImpl.java
- Search criteria object `CashPointSearch` (locationUuid, name, includeRetired) api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/search/CashPointSearch.java

**Bill creation — the crucial rule**
On a new bill, if no cash point was posted, `BillResource.save` calls `loadBillCashPoint` omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/BillResource.java. That method looks up the cashier's open timesheet and takes its cash point: if a timesheet exists it uses `timesheet.getCashPoint()`, erroring if it is null; if there is no current timesheet it either throws when the `billing.timesheetRequired` global property is set, copies the cash point from the adjusted bill, or throws "Cash point cannot be null!" omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/BillResource.java. The open timesheet is selected by cashier with a null `clockOut` api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/api/impl/TimesheetServiceImpl.java.

**REST / legacy web**
- `CashPointResource` at `/billing/cashPoint`, a `MetadataDelegatingCrudResource` with get-all, get-by-uuid, save, retire-on-delete and purge omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/CashPointResource.java
- `CashPointSearchHandler` for the `q`/location search omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/search/CashPointSearchHandler.java
- `TimesheetResource` exposes cash point as a `REF` representation omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/TimesheetResource.java
- `CashPointPropertyEditor` converts an id or UUID string to a CashPoint for legacy form binding api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/propertyeditor/CashPointPropertyEditor.java
- Legacy page controller `/module/billing/cashPoints` omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/legacyweb/controller/CashPointsController.java

**Frontend (billing app)**
- `useCashPoint` fetches `/cashPoint` src/billing-form/billing-form.resource.ts; the check-in form posts the first cash point's UUID as `cashPoint` when creating the bill src/billing-form/billing-checkin-form.component.tsx
- Admin UI: `AddCashPointModal` creates cash points via `POST /billing/cashPoint` src/billable-services/cash-point/add-cash-point.modal.tsx and `cash-point-configuration.component.tsx` lists them src/billable-services/cash-point/cash-point-configuration.component.tsx
- Config default `postBilledItems.cashPoint` src/config-schema.ts
- `CashPoint` type and the invoice fields src/types/index.ts
- Seed data goes in a content package at `cashpoints/cashPoints.csv` README.md

The cash point is the module's *till*: a metadata-defined cashier station under an OpenMRS location. It is required on every bill and timesheet, it decides which station a bill's money belongs to, it can group receipt numbers, and it is the filter dimension for cash reports. On bill creation it is not trusted from the client — the backend re-derives it from the cashier's open timesheet unless the `billing.timesheetRequired` property is off omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/web/rest/resource/BillResource.java.
One thing I did not check: I found no dedicated cash-point reporting endpoint beyond the `cashPointUuid` bill filter, so I cannot confirm whether the O3 docs describe a reconciliation report.
